0022600200.text: Boston (7-2, winners of two straight, 2nd in the East and 1 game back in the Atlantic) visits Milwaukee (1-8, five straight losses, 15th in the East and 5.5 games back in the Central), with the Celtics 2-2 on the road and the Bucks 1-4 at home. The teams have met once this season, with Boston winning 109-102 in Boston on Nov. 4, and the Celtics also won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision for Boston, while Gary Trent Jr. is out for Milwaukee with an illness.
